procedure: 1. Share one Engine across several threads issuing concurrent top-level operations; confirm serialized admission (no deadlock under load) and that each completed result equals the single-threaded result. 2. Repeat the same fixture with 1, 2 and 8 workers and require identical identities, facts and errors. 3. Interleave failures and cancellations, then verify the Engine remains usable for a follow-up successful operation. 4. Drop Artifacts and Engines in varied orders and confirm the pool is destroyed after the last handle and retained input permits are recycled (thread census after quiesce).
pass_criteria: Concurrent admission never deadlocks and every result matches the sequential run; worker counts do not change identities or errors; post-failure/post-cancel Engine reuse works; pool lifetime follows the last handle with permits recycled.
